integrity: The proof first converts every neighborhood condition into a parity-set symmetric-difference criterion, then combines it with the rigid form of color classes that can meet both sides of a crown graph. The checker independently enumerates proper colorings and tests the definition for all palettes through the minimum on n=3..9.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to crown graphs K_{n,n}-M with n at least three.
The parameter is the proper neighborhood-parity odd chromatic number introduced by Petruševski and Škrekovski, not odd induced-subgraph partition coloring.
No statement is made for arbitrary bipartite graphs or for deletion of a non-perfect matching.
Finite exhaustive verification over 3 <= n <= 9 is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently named or non-indexed crown-graph treatment.
title: Neighborhood-parity odd colorings of crown graphs
